name: neko
description: An xneko-style pixel-art cat (tabby or black): up on the ceiling of the fullscreen transcript it chases the conversation as it scrolls and bats Claude's words about; in its band above the prompt it chases your cursor and pointer, purrs when stroked, naps and hunts mice

style.title: Style
style.description: pixel: colour pixel art; ascii: coloured ASCII; auto: pixel art where the terminal has true colour

place.title: Place
place.description: ceiling: up in the top third of the fullscreen transcript, over the conversation, chasing it as it scrolls and batting words about (the band elsewhere); band: in its own band above the prompt
